mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id FROM organization_access.tenant_lifecycle WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT subject_id, login_name, password_hash, status, version, created_at FROM organization_access.subject_identity WHERE subject_id = #{subjectId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE

SELECT subject.subject_id, subject.login_name, subject.password_hash, subject.status, subject.version, subject.created_at FROM organization_access.tenant_membership membership INNER JOIN organization_access.subject_identity subject ON subject.subject_id = membership.subject_id WHERE membership.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND membership.membership_id = #{membershipId} FOR UPDATE OF subject
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM organization_access.platform_role_binding WHERE subject_id = #{subjectId} AND role_code = 'PLATFORM_ADMINISTRATOR' AND status = 'ACTIVE' )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO organization_access.tenant_membership (membership_id, tenant_id, subject_id, membership_role, status, permission_version, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{membershipId}, #{tenantId}, #{subjectId}, #{role}, #{status}, #{permissionVersion}, #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{createdAt})
INSERT INTO organization_access.tenant_membership_role_binding (tenant_id, membership_id, role_code, bound_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{membershipId}, 'TENANT_ADMINISTRATOR', #{boundAt})
mapper.select: SELECT membership.membership_id, subject.login_name, membership.status, membership.permission_version, membership.version, membership.created_at, CASE WHEN subject.updated_at > subject.created_at OR membership.updated_at > membership.created_at THEN GREATEST(subject.updated_at, membership.updated_at) ELSE NULL END AS last_security_change_at FROM organization_access.tenant_membership membership INNER JOIN organization_access.subject_identity subject ON subject.subject_id = membership.subject_id WHERE membership.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND membership.membership_role = 'TENANT_ADMINISTRATOR' AND lower(subject.login_name) LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '\' AND (#{status} = 'ALL' OR membership.status = #{status}) ORDER BY lower(subject.login_name), membership.membership_id LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT count(*) FROM organization_access.tenant_membership membership INNER JOIN organization_access.subject_identity subject ON subject.subject_id = membership.subject_id WHERE membership.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND membership.membership_role = 'TENANT_ADMINISTRATOR' AND lower(subject.login_name) LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '\' AND (#{status} = 'ALL' OR membership.status = #{status})

SELECT subject.subject_id, subject.login_name, subject.status FROM organization_access.subject_identity subject WHERE subject.status = 'ACTIVE' AND lower(subject.login_name) LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '\' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM organization_access.platform_role_binding binding WHERE binding.subject_id = subject.subject_id AND binding.role_code = 'PLATFORM_ADMINISTRATOR' AND binding.status = 'ACTIVE' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM organization_access.tenant_membership membership WHERE membership.subject_id = subject.subject_id AND membership.membership_role = 'TENANT_ADMINISTRATOR' ) ORDER BY lower(subject.login_name), subject.subject_id LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT count(*) FROM organization_access.subject_identity subject WHERE subject.status = 'ACTIVE' AND lower(subject.login_name) LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '\' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM organization_access.platform_role_binding binding WHERE binding.subject_id = subject.subject_id AND binding.role_code = 'PLATFORM_ADMINISTRATOR' AND binding.status = 'ACTIVE' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM organization_access.tenant_membership membership WHERE membership.subject_id = subject.subject_id AND membership.membership_role = 'TENANT_ADMINISTRATOR' )
